description: The SPECIAL-NAMES ORDER TABLE ordering-name-1 IS literal-9 clause, §2023:12.3.7.2 (the last item of the paragraph's general format) - introduced 2002 with the cultural-ordering facility. Literal-9 identifies a cultural ordering table constructed per ISO/IEC 14651:2020 Annex A and the implementor specifies its allowable content (§2023:12.3.7.4 GR17); ordering-name-1 may be specified only in the STANDARD-COMPARE intrinsic function (§2023:12.3.7.3 SR9). THE EDGE IS QUOTED from the edition texts (kb/Work PB3965): the 1985 SPECIAL-NAMES paragraph 'provides a means for specifying the currency sign' and the other 1985 clauses (§1985:VI.4.5.1), and its general format closes '[CURRENCY SIGN IS literal-6] [DECIMAL-POINT IS COMMA].]' (§1985:VI.4.5.2), with no ORDER TABLE clause; the 2002 format prints '[ ORDER TABLE ordering-name-1 IS literal-9 ]' (§2002:12.2.6.1), 'Ordering-name-1 may be specified only in the STANDARD-COMPARE intrinsic function' (§2002:12.2.6.2 SR9) and 'When ORDERING TABLE is specified, ordering-name-1 references an ordering table constructed in accordance with ISO/IEC 14651:2001' (§2002:12.2.6.3 GR17); §2002:F.2 records the facility, item 42 ('Support is provided for using local conventions that depend on language and culture') and item 78 ('Intrinsic functions. New intrinsic functions are:'), whose table lists STANDARD-COMPARE. 2014 keeps the clause (§2014:12.3.6.1; §2014:12.3.6.2 SR9; §2014:12.3.6.3 GR17 'When ORDER TABLE is specified, ordering-name-1 references a cultural ordering table'). Parse-arm gated on recognition (VisitOrderTableClause). The grammar predicate is NOT edition-gated, unlike the LOCALE clause's: ORDER and TABLE are reserved at every edition (reserved-words.json r85 true for both), so the pair ORDER + TABLE has no competing COBOL-85 reading, and recognizing it everywhere is what makes the sub-2002 answer this explanatory COBOL0900 instead of a parse error at TABLE.
vcr: 2002 introduction (the cultural-ordering facility; §2002:12.2.6.1 / §2002:F.2 items 42 and 78; VCR row 7.19; kb/Work PB101 - ORDER TABLE + STANDARD-COMPARE over the CLDR/UCA collation engine)
